message: ソバがために僕は泣く

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nnn... Something besides soba, something besides soba...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heheh... No need to force yourself to think so hard.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think sticking with soba would be the most like you, Nanaka.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heck, your name's Soba too. Soba.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm Nanaka! 'Soba' is just a stupid nickname you made up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, if it's soba, you can just bring it from home. Nothing beats free, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing is more expensive than free! I can't just go dipping into my family's daily livelihood!」

name: Synn
message: 「But you bring it over to my place all the time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heheh... Synn-sama, you really are a mean one. Isn't it obvious? It's love, love!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's nothing like that! Your parents asked me to take care of their son, that's all!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know. Thanks as always.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As long as you understand.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... He thanked me with a totally straight face...」

name: Synn
message: 「Seriously though, you don't have to push yourself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean, push myself?! I know plenty of other ingredients!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aha. Soba's planning to toss sweets into the pot.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if I'd ever do that!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why soba would be totally fine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrrr! I will. Definitely. Bring something that isn't soba!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh! A ton of ideas just came to me! Now I'm actually torn on what to buy!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's amazing, Nanaka!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that really something to praise her for?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「First up, green onions, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Those are a must-have for hot pot, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Next is daikon radish, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. That goes great in hot pot too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey... no, I'll hold my tongue.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「If it's green onions and daikon you're after, I just got some great ones in! Hardly any root hairs sprouting, and above all, look at this sheen! This firmness!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa-whoa.」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-What's with this weirdly wide, blatantly shameless old hag!」
The lady from Shinagawa Greengrocer. The source of all the shopping district's rumors, commonly known as Shina-oba, had a sharp glint flash in her eyes.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh-ho. This panda Plushie talks, doesn't it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh-heh-heh... don't go falling for yours truly.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Where'd you get your hands on this? No, don't even tell me, I already know. Uh-huh. You sure have it rough, don'tcha.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Your old man went and foisted some weird thing on you again, didn't he. So, what kind of cursed item is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it a cursed item?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Calling the Great Sage Paqy-sama a curse--what a rude piece of work.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Pretty silver-tongued for a mere cursed item, aren'tcha!」
Shina-oba's eyes began to gleam fiercely.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「How about we nibble on some ankoromochi while you tell me all about your life story so far.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Something like mere ankoromochi ain't gonna satisfy a gourmet like yours truly.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Well then, I'll throw in some kashiwamochi too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Auntie. Synn will probably tell you all you want about that plushie later, so for now, I'd like to do my shopping.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oops. My bad. Well, my blood as a seeker of truth just got pumping. Also, sansho pepper, wasabi, and nameko mushrooms, right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, h-how did you know?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「'Cause that's what you always buy, Nanaka-chan. Here you go. Thanks for your business~」

name: Synn
message: 「Every single one of those is a condiment or topping for soba noodles.」

name: Synn
message: 「Green onions and daikon radishes go great in a hot pot, so isn't that fine?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Give it up, Soba. Your brain's ninety-nine percent contaminated with soba anyway, so just live out your life as a soba girl to the fullest, soba.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop saying soba! You stupid panda! Just a stupid panda, a stupid panda!」

name: Synn
message: 「But hey, being soba isn't necessarily a bad thing. We don't have to worry about anyone else bringing the same thing, and besides, we already bought it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I guess, but still...」

name: Paqy
message: 「As expected of Synn-sama. Spotting a woman in down spirits and immediately smoothing things over. Swooning her heart and soul, only to make her party dessert.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't go fabricating what's in my heart.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When everyone else sees me bringing these, they're gonna look at me like 'Ah, of course'... Ugh! That just pisses me off!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I got it! Trying to run away from soba is why my thinking was so limited! I need to charge straight into close-quarters combat with soba!」

name: Synn
message: 「I think you're already pretty close as it is...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing ventured, nothing gained! You've gotta find life in the face of death!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's on fire...」

name: Paqy
message: 「She catches fire as easily as kerosene.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heheh! It hit me right away! I'm on a roll!」

name: Synn
message: 「That was fast.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Something that uses the exact same ingredient as soba, yet isn't soba! That would be--!」

name: Synn
message: 「That would be?」
Nanaka grinned and flashed a V sign.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heheh. That would be--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sobagaki!」
Well... as long as Nanaka's satisfied, I guess it's fine.
